preconditions.description: n is an integer between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of colors k is 1 if n < 3 (no prime divides another in the set), otherwise 2.
The output contains exactly n color assignments.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= c <= k for c in colors)
postconditions.description: Every assigned color is an integer between 1 and k inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(not (is_prime(p_i) and p_j % p_i == 0 and colors[i-1] == colors[j-1]) for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, n+1) if i != j)
postconditions.description: For any two distinct pieces with prices p_i = i+1 and p_j = j+1, if p_i is a prime divisor of p_j, their colors must be different.
The reported k is the minimum number of colors required to satisfy the constraints.
